  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment is neutral or negative, especially after recent spikes.",
    "Reduce forecast overshoots following high historical prices (e.g., >70) by applying a 5-10% downward bias.",
    "Apply mean reversion correction: if forecast is >10% above recent 7-day average, reduce by 10-20%.",
    "Increase forecast sensitivity to sentiment shifts: if sentiment turns positive, raise forecast by 3-5% for next 3 days.",
    "Avoid overreacting to short-term volatility: if true outcome deviates >15% from forecast, re-evaluate model horizon and sentiment alignment."
  ]
